openItems.explanation: Check 5521 from Calder Street Lofts LLC for $32,414.00, deposited October 27, sits in 2050 unapplied. The deposit has no remittance advice, so it was held in 2050 Unapplied Customer Payments and INV-3371 still shows open on the aging. Calder Street Lofts LLC has exactly one open invoice for that amount: INV-3371, pay application 5, dated August 31, $32,414.00, now 61 days old. Matched by customer and amount under AR-3, AJ-01 applies the receipt: it clears 2050 and takes INV-3371 off the aging. Confirm the match with the customer before it is posted.

openItems.id: Signed Change Order Not Billed · AR-4, AR-2
openItems.explanation: CO-03 on job S-2601, $26,300.00, signed by the owner October 8, is not on pay application 6. Pay application 6 (INV-3419, $135,470.00 due) carries only CO-01, CO-02 and a contract sum of $1,268,250.00; CO-03 raises it to $1,294,550.00. The contract log shows CO-03 60% complete at October 31 and nothing billed on it, so $15,780.00 of work done in October was not billed (AR-4). AJ-02 bills it: $14,991.00 to receivables and $789.00 of 5% retainage (AR-2), against contract revenue. Send it as a supplemental pay application, or add it to pay application 7; the CO-01 on S-2604 is not signed and stays unbilled.

Credit CR-07 for $6,450.00, agreed with Ridgecrest Veterinary Clinic PC on October 12, was never issued. Both sides approved CR-07 on October 12 for deleted scope, to be applied to INV-3388. No credit memo was issued in October; the register's last one is CM-0204 of August 20. The customer paid INV-3388 on October 29 less the credit ($45,930.00 of $52,380.00), so $6,450.00 still shows open and ages as if it were owed. AJ-03 issues the credit memo under AR-5: it reduces contract revenue and clears INV-3388. Nothing is owed and no reminder is sent.

The allowance is $6,180.00; AR-7 on the corrected aging requires $17,195.72. After the proposed corrections the aging is $451,212.00: $342,667.00 at 1% in 0-30 days, $60,760.00 at 3% in 31-60 days, $0.00 at 10% in 61-90 days, $47,785.00 at 25% in over 90 days. At the AR-7 rates that requires $17,195.72; GL 1290 has carried $6,180.00 since September. AJ-04 adds $11,015.72 to bad debt expense. Most of it, $11,946.25, is the over 90 days bucket. The formula leaves out retainage; a specific reserve for any of it is the Controller's decision.

Orchard Gate Owners Association owes $47,785.00 on invoices INV-3342 and INV-3356, all over 90 days. INV-3342 of June 30 is 123 days old with $28,880.00 open. INV-3356 of July 31 is 92 days old with $18,905.00 open. On September 15 the board treasurer promised $47,785.00 by September 30; nothing came. Of the 5 contacts on file, 2 got no reply and the last, on October 29, was a call that left a voicemail. Under AR-6 the Controller calls now, using the call script drafted in this package, and the account goes on credit hold. Work ended August 14, so the policy's working lien date is November 12, 2026: ask counsel to confirm it before then. Retainage of $21,350.00 on this contract is not aged and is not in the allowance formula; a person decides whether to reserve it specifically (AR-7).
